notes: Volumes 2–6 screened for sermon material; preserve Messiah as a complete 50-discourse series and distinguish Discourses Intended for the Pulpit from documented delivery.

Posthumous New York reprint from the London edition directed by Newton's executors. Volume VI's advertisement distinguishes author-approved letters, periodical essays, and the previously printed 1800 sermon. Messiah is author-abridged; the 1800 sermon was reconstructed from memory, as its advertisement states.
Mixed-volume contents are not all sermons by the named preacher. Only explicitly inventoried components enter sermon counts.
